# An N1MM Logger+ call-history file as an operator imports it. ONE file for both halves of Nexus
# that read it: crates/tempo-app/src/call_history.rs (the parse, and the band map's predicted
# multipliers) and ui/src/features/callHistoryFill.ts (the contest strip's fill). What each
# should make of it is in call-history-expected.json beside it.
!!order!!,call,NAME,loc1,State,SECT,cqzone,UserText
